description: This PHP class file defines the LeaveEntitlementReport controller within the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It manages the rendering of a leave entitlement report component, initializing the component with subunit data, location data, and the current leave period, utilizing services for company structure, location, and leave period information.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementReport
classes.description: Controller class responsible for preparing and rendering the leave entitlement report view in the OrangeHRM leave plugin.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LocationService.

methods.name: getCompanyStructureService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of CompanyStructureService.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the leave entitlement report component by setting properties related to subunits, locations, and current leave period before rendering.
